title: The target lock (who you are fighting)
oneLine: S.lockedTarget: auto vs tap monster locks, fighter locks, latch, far drop; 38 writers in 12 files.
topConcern: Only targeting.js's 8 drops stamp the why and clear the lock's aim; clearLockAim is private, so 30 outside drops cannot.

title: Where the aim came from (_aimSrc provenance)
oneLine: _aimAngle/_aimSrc/_aiming/_lastAimAngle: who wrote the aim, so a lock's aim dies with the lock.
topConcern: A kill's lock clear skips clearLockAim; the stale bearing then draws the sword/bow pose one way while the hit goes another.

title: "I picked this fight" (melee engagement)
oneLine: _engagedId/_engaged/_engagedGapAt: the tapped monster that keeps the sword auto-swinging after the lock moves.
topConcern: Ends only when the chosen monster dies or leaves S.monsters; a far Wheel copy never leaves, so later monsters get unrequested swings.

title: May I attack now? (the held-attack fire gate)
oneLine: autoAttack/engage/tap-attack drive the loop's shots and swings through one gate; presses use playerActions' own.
topConcern: The loop never asks isStaggered: a held attack keeps swinging and sending after a parry the v2.3.3264 contract says sends nothing.

title: A melee swing (start, contact, sweep, end)
oneLine: isSwinging/swingTimer/_specialAttack/_swingBcastPending/_hitThisSwing: one sword swing's wind, contact, sweep and end.
topConcern: A press's first (tapped) swing never raises _swingBcastPending, so peers never see a tapped swing, only a hold's later ones.

title: The bow's sight gate and the queued bow special
oneLine: _bowSight per frame and _bowSpecialQueued (2.5 s): the bow looses only on a line; a special waits for one.
topConcern: The queue is consumed only inside the held-attack gate; the Special button and the flick queue with no thumb held, so it lapses.

title: A player projectile from nock to removal
oneLine: S.arrows entries: queued, nocked, flying, landing, stuck/burning, planting, planted, in a rock, spent, removed.
topConcern: A stuck special holds the monster object, not its id; after a list replace it bills and rides a frozen copy for its whole burn.

title: A monster's shot on its way to you
oneLine: S.slimeProjectiles: the worker's display-only balls and the dormant local orbs, each ending in one burst queue.

title: The once-per-life remnant pile, in a worker's zone
oneLine: m._localRemnantDropped: one local remnant pile per monster life, dropped when a monster sits alive at 0 hp.
topConcern: Every swelling slime's first life drops a claimable phantom pile beside the worker's; the flag is never reset by the worker's respawn.

title: The sword's local kill, in a worker's zone
oneLine: The melee kill block (local XP, coin pile, alive=false) has no server-zone gate; the arrow's does.
topConcern: Any server monster held alive at 0 hp lets a swing run the single-player kill; v2.3.2226 closed it only for the swelling slime.

title: Other players' damage numbers, held and dripped out
oneLine: Per-source peer popup queue with an 80 ms release cadence, 600 ms force and a zone-change wipe.
topConcern: _peerDmgLastRel is pruned only on a zone change, and the Wheel is one zone (small).

title: Styling your own server-rolled numbers
oneLine: _ownSpecialRecent (sticky boolean) and _ownCollisionRecent (fresh-checked) dress the worker's number for your hits.
topConcern: After one sword special every later own number (arrows, ticks, PvP) is drawn as a special; ranged specials never are.

title: "This monster is after me" flags written by your own hits
oneLine: m._aggroed/_aggroTs/_chaseUntil/_kbUntil stamped on the worker's monsters by your hits; cleared only by tick tg.
topConcern: tg is sent only while targeting (+2 s) and the worker respawn keeps _aggroed, so the reach ring can take a monster not after you.

title: The local monster brain
oneLine: Client-owned monster AI: aggro, archetype moves, boss idle/telegraph/attack/recovery, telegraph strike, local respawn.
topConcern: Dormant; its _invulnerable flag is shared with the live burrow and refuses hits before monster_damage is sent.

title: Dying to a local monster (third copy of death and respawn)
oneLine: _dying/_deathStart/respawnTimer + a 3.5 s setTimeout teleport, reachable only from a local monster's blow.
topConcern: Third copy of the respawn; goes to 'town' without the Wheel trip and cannot be cancelled. Dormant.

title: Use-trained Tier-1 stats
oneLine: _buildUse tally split on a kill into _buildProg; a threshold raises a T1 stat and sends build_point_earned.
topConcern: Stat level-ups and grid points are decided on the phone; the worker recomputes on its word (known, inert under prog3).

title: The periodic local save (every 180 frames)
oneLine: _rpgSaveTimer frame counter: localStorage bt_rpg plus a syncRpgToServer whose RPC is a no-op.
topConcern: A full JSON serialisation thrown away every ~3 s (1.25 s at 144 Hz): btRpc returns null.

title: The ranged attack's pose windows
oneLine: _bowShotAt/_bowShotAng and _staffCastAt/_staffCastAng/_staffCadenceMs stamped at fire, drawn for a fixed window.

title: Claims against players from a swing (and the dead threat timer)
oneLine: Per-frame player_attack sends throttled per swing (pvpSwing.js), painted under the same rule; per-shot claims.
topConcern: S._pvpThreat is written at three sites and read nowhere: a phase that gates nothing.

title: A sword swing through a townsperson
oneLine: npc._hitThisSwing, shove and sound; the hp/death/respawn half is unreachable (every townsperson is noHp).

title: Impact rings: the producer's lifetime vs the cleanup's
oneLine: Rings carry their own duration/startDelay; stateCleanup removes all at a flat 400 ms before the renderer's end.
topConcern: The big staff bolt's blast ring is cut at age 0.83, never drawn past ~91% of the radius the worker hits.

title: A worker's monster as drawn: eased position, split arc, hit recoil
oneLine: renderX/Y easing and snap, the split arc (_popFrom), and the hit recoil/flash windows.

title: The phone's own elemental statuses and collisions, and what they award
oneLine: Local status clocks and collisions beside the worker's; certificates and the Codex awarded from the local roll.
topConcern: Certs and Codex entries can be earned for a collision the worker never resolved, and live only in this browser.
